entities.summary: Gabriel Moraru is a retired Romanian tennis player and a tennis coach, currently is the General Manager of Romanian Tennis Federation.Since 2017 he is the coach of fellow Romanian Ana Bogdan. On 25 July 2005 he reached his highest ATP singles ranking of World No. 234 whilst his best doubles ranking was World No. 125 on 19 September 2005.
